usageNotes: Stops one or all Ceph services on a specific PVE node; omitting 'service' stops the entire ceph.target unit, which halts all Ceph daemons (MON, OSD, MGR, MDS) on that node. Use when decommissioning a node from the Ceph cluster, performing maintenance, or diagnosing daemon-level issues. Returns a task UPID string — poll the task endpoint to confirm completion before assuming services are fully stopped.

examples.summary: Stop all Ceph services on node pve1 (default ceph.target)

destructiveReason: Stopping Ceph services on a node removes that node's OSDs and MON from active cluster participation, reducing redundancy and potentially causing I/O degradation or client-visible storage interruptions if the cluster lacks sufficient remaining active OSDs to maintain quorum or the configured replication count.
tips: To stop a single daemon rather than all services, pass the 'service' param using the pattern e.g. 'osd.0' or 'mon.pve1'.
Before stopping on a multi-OSD node, verify the cluster is HEALTH_OK and has enough remaining OSDs to maintain the replication minimum (default min_size=2).
Use 'get_nodes_node_ceph_status' to check cluster health before and after this call.
Stopping services does not remove them from the cluster config — use the appropriate remove/destroy endpoints for permanent removal.
